headline: Sanofi to Acquire Biotech Firm Insmed for $41 Billion
summary: French drugmaker Sanofi has agreed to acquire U.S. biotech company Insmed for $41 billion. The acquisition aims to help Sanofi offset upcoming patent expirations on a key drug.
why: Sanofi is one of Europe's largest pharmaceutical manufacturers, while Insmed is a U.S. biopharmaceutical company focused on treatments for rare diseases.
